rationale: The blind translation expresses a general exact real-linear-algebra fact about scaled orthogonal matrices. The paper result is instead a complex Fourier backward-error interpretation for an FFT-generated roundoff error, with fixed sqrt(N) scaling and two first-order certificates depending on epsilon, K(N,gamma), x, and O(epsilon^2). The translation omits those certificates and the complete numerical and algorithmic context while introducing arbitrary real matrices, scales, vectors, and a zero-dimensional case. Neither statement semantically implies the other, so the result is not-faithful-different.
